attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry names all three of its members, so it is one folder per named member and each relates the others. The corpus keeps many men called Leo on other days; this entry is its own commemoration and nothing on the page joins it to any of them. No year, so no `dates` object. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
